name: {{PROJECT_NAME}}
description: This repository is a Claude project kept as files: the instructions, the goal, the shared memory and the board that Claude Code reads in every session, local or cloud, live here under version control. It came from a GitHub template that brings the folder structure, the checks and the workflows already set up, so a new project starts with the whole arrangement in place. Each Claude account sets up a claude.ai Project from this repository with one click and no Claude prompt: the repository carries export.json, which describes it as a cswap project export, and cswap's import, run in the person's own browser, makes the Project with its description, its instructions, its memory and this repository linked. From then on the repository is the one place every account and every session agrees on.
instructions: This Project works on {{REPO}}. Read CLAUDE.md first. The shared memory is docs/memory/ (read MEMORY.md); the board is the file STATE.md on the branch board, read with: git fetch origin board && git show origin/board:STATE.md; work is claimed as docs/agents/PROTOCOL.md says: one issue, one branch claude/<issue>, one pull request. A fact worth keeping goes to docs/memory/ by pull request, not only into this Project's memory.
